scenes.sub: You love harder than you're loved back.

scenes.text: You remember *everything* about the people you love.
scenes.sub: Birthdays. Favourite food. That one bad day.
Venus rules you. A messy room actually bothers you.

scenes.text: You avoid fights so much it *hurts* you.
scenes.sub: Peace at any price is still a price.

scenes.text:
Send this to the *6*
who takes care of everyone
scenes.sub: They need to hear it today.
